profile.headline: Web Developer @ Purdue | Crafting Engaging Web Experiences
profile.summary:
As a Web Developer at Purdue University College of Education, I apply my 10+ years of experience in digital marketing to create and manage web content. I hold multiple certifications in web development, as well as a Master of Science in Applied Health Science and a Bachelor of Arts in Journalism from Indiana University Bloomington.

I am passionate about enhancing the web experience for Purdue's students, faculty and staff, and I continuously seek to learn new skills and technologies to keep up with the evolving digital landscape.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: West Lafayette, Indiana, United States · Remote
positions.description: Skills: Web Development · Web Content Management · Web Content Creation

positions.title: Senior Communications Specialist
positions.description:
- Lead global digital marketing activity including creating digital marketing plans for product launches, tradeshows and campaigns and coordinating with partner agencies and global regions as required.
- Serve as content owner for all pages on allisontransmission.com, organize ongoing updates and manage web translations process.
- Lead social media strategy, content creation and engagement across Allison social presence
- Serve as site owner for digital asset management system, Brand Connect. Provide global user training, regularly update architecture and ensure timely upload and tagging of assets.
- Measure and report performance of all digital marketing campaigns. Create monthly/quarterly analytics reports.
- Managed design, layout and distribution of all global marketing emails. Implemented email best practices for all global tradeshows.
- Managed voice of customer surveys for global customer events. Collaborated with regional sales teams to distribute surveys after customer visits to Allison facilities in North America and Europe. 
- Served as an international event manager as needed. Collaborated with international vendors and global staff to provide guidance on product placement, guest experience, booth media and design.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Content Management · Email Marketing · Digital Strategy · Press Releases · Content Strategy · Digital Marketing · Analytical Skills · Social Media Communications · Content Management · Writing · Microsoft Office

positions.title: Digital Content Coordinator
positions.description:
- Maintain and update the ASDA and Engage sites for accuracy and timeliness
- Manage layout and distribution of promotional emails and e-newsletters
- Responsible for strategy and implementation of ASDA's Instagram, Pinterest and Snapchat
- Design collateral for social media and website
- Manage association data and create bi-annual analytics reports
positions.insights: Skills: Web Content Management · Email Marketing · Content Strategy · Social Media Communications · Writing · Microsoft Office

positions.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
positions.description:
Managed social media for the district and more than 180 school accounts
Managed district website and 60 school websites
Designed collateral for social media, email, advertising, web and mobile
Managed major creative projects including video, print and digital promotions

positions.title: Web and Social Media Coordinator
positions.description:
• Managed district social media accounts on various platforms including, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Vine, and Google+
• Oversaw over 30 school and district program social media accounts
• Managed district web site and 60 school web sites
• Created and distribute a weekly community e-newsletter
• Wrote press releases and communicated with media as needed
• Measured and tracked the statistics of the accounts using worksheets, tables and graphs
• Collaborated with outside community organizations for promoting messages and
content
• Monitored social media daily for possible interactions, positive and negative
• Assisted school web coordinators with web sites and programs
• Coordinated with other departments on planning and promoting district events
• Provided training on web development and social media
• Photographed district events for use on web site and social media

positions.title: Social Media Coordinator
positions.description:
• Coordinated with Indiana University Athletics, Indiana University Police Department, Indiana University Emergency Management, and Indiana University Event Services to monitor and deliver event-specific public safety social media messages
• Created a policy on how to approach potentially damaging messages to the
organization
• Established voice and tone for the account
• Developed a social media plan for each Indiana University football and basketball
game regarding time and content-specific messages
• Measured and tracked the statistics of the account using worksheets, tables and graphs

positions.title: Team Leader
positions.description:
• Supervised 12 or more student employees per shift on aspects relating to facility and safety assessments, security and emergency response
• Responsible for programmatic, relational and problem solving situations in a fast- paced environment which served 3,500-5,500 participants daily
• Served as a first responder to incidents and completed incident investigations
• Implemented emergency evacuation procedures in the event of severe weather or fire
• Trained new employees on facility policies and procedures and assisted in the hiring
process
• Responded to a life-threatening situation where I assisted in the successful
administration of CPR and the use of an AED

positions.title: Graduate Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a social media and public relations plan for the department
• Wrote emergency preparedness blog posts weekly for the department website
• Developed a social media initiative to create a public safety account for the
university athletic department
• Created and distributed new marketing materials for all eight university campuses
• Developed an emergency preparedness outreach plan for students and faculty
• Developed processes and policies for instructing CPR/AED/First Aid classes for
university faculty and staff
